references.comparisonLimit: Guest distro/build identity and workload differ. RSS reference is a physical Cinnamon Qt6.4.2 cold or controlled empty-view observation; these are long-lived guest process snapshots, not matching workloads.

conclusions.claim: KDE really held 179.22265625 MiB process RSS at 20:17:55Z; dashboard reviewer independently reports the same PID/RSS at about20:18:55Z and fresh sampling. Its figure is not a MiB conversion error or a host-QEMU total.
conclusions.limits: A current snapshot, not a standardized cold score or full-session memory trajectory.

conclusions.claim: All three guest residents are different binaries from both the measured and rebuilt current candidate. Their executable DT_NEEDED directly lists AWS core/S3, curl and QtNetwork, confirming the earlier resident-link architecture. SDK residency here is not evidence that the newer deferred module loads during cold local work.
support: same PID+startTicks supplementary readelf dependency checks
conclusions.limits: Exact Git source commits of guest executables were not established; package version0.1.0 alone cannot establish them.

conclusions.claim: KDE RSS is dominated by shared/native runtime pages:118.67578125 MiB shared-clean, with LLVM48.27734375 MiB RSS/5.6875 MiB PSS and Gallium10.125 MiB RSS/1.6787109375 MiB PSS. KDE total PSS66.666015625 MiB and private52.9765625 MiB remain substantial, but differ from total RSS.
conclusions.limits: Shared code is real resident memory but charging its full RSS to every process double-counts system use. Debug sections on disk are not loaded RSS; no claim uses executable file size.

conclusions.claim: The KDE compositor is confirmed to use llvmpipe software rendering by its read-only supportInformation renderer and Driver fields. App LLVM/Gallium and native QtQuick/KF6 mappings align with a software graphics/native KDE integration cost.
conclusions.limits: KWin renderer confirmation does not by itself identify the application own GL context or prove which native feature first loaded each library. No graphics setting was changed.

conclusions.claim: GNOME/KDE use distro Qt6.10.2; Cinnamon uses Qt6.4.2. Heap RSS is23.199/30.121/3.867 MiB respectively and shared memfd RSS6.172/7.570/0. These support differing retained app/window usage and native platform costs, not a single comparable cold workload.
conclusions.limits: Application view history/active operations/state and live-versus-free heap partition were deliberately not inspected. Memfd contents and labels outside the recognized whitelist are not exported. No leak diagnosis is supported.

unknowns: Exact running guest source commits and whether each contains unrelated later fixes.
Whether the resident views are currently open or were previously opened, and what actions occurred before sampling.
Which heap pages are live widget/data allocations versus reusable/free allocator pages; smaps does not expose that distinction.
Application GL renderer and the exact trigger for loading QtQuick, LLVM and Gallium; only compositor renderer confirmed.
Fresh same-source/same-workload guest cold, post-view and native-dialog costs; no restart or experiment was authorized/performed.
proposedNextStep: First deploy the same reviewed optimization source through each distro-native build/package and compare verified binary identities on fresh test overlays, then run separately authorized matching cold/post-view workloads. Do not remove native fonts/dialogs or disable native integration based on this snapshot. No installs/restarts/workload changes were made during this audit.

safetyAndLimits: Only existing running-overlay SSH and read-only /proc, ELF metadata, package versions, and filtered KWin supportInformation were used. No boot/restart/install/app GUI/config/source/index/build/test/storage/clipboard/upload/cloud actions.
No guest executable, VM base disk or unrelated user file was modified. VNC listeners and display output remained available. SSH statistics are not graphical acceptance.

No credential/private-key contents, user config/payload/environment/command lines/raw mapped memory were read/exported. Arbitrary mapped files are aggregated without filenames; system libraries/fonts and recognized kernel regions alone are named.
All three status+smaps snapshots succeeded, with no swaps. Same guest PID/startTicks confirmed by supplemental metadata read. Snapshot categories reconcile exactly to rollup RSS.
No cold-budget, measured savings, helper-total-cost or40MiB target claim; actual guest use history is unknown.
